findings.title: Existing artifact collision target could have been a symlink
findings.resolution: Artifact insertion now lstat-checks an existing collision target and rejects anything except a regular, non-symlink file before reading it.

findings.title: Cancellation escalation used child.killed instead of observed exit
findings.resolution: The runner now tracks the close event and force-terminates after the bounded grace period only while the owned child has not exited.

findings.title: Non-zero native exits lost typed native errors
findings.resolution: Bounded stdout is parsed first so qualified native classifications survive; a non-zero exit paired with success content maps to PROCESS_CRASH.
